items.name: interlace-base
items.title: Interlace Base
items.description: @interlace/ui — the additive CSS baseline every component needs: motion tokens, type scale, container widths, the xs breakpoint, radius derived from --radius, layered brand + semantic colour tokens in OKLCH, and a color-scheme that follows the dark class so native controls match. Changes nothing the host app already styles.

items.name: theme
items.title: Interlace Theme
items.description: @interlace/ui — the Interlace look as shadcn cssVars: points your --primary, --background, --radius and the rest at Interlace's burnt-orange brand tokens (light + dark, AAA). Opt-in; components work without it.

items.name: interlace-foundation
items.title: Interlace Foundation
items.description: @interlace/ui — opt-in page-level styling: Inter and JetBrains Mono on font-sans / font-mono, the preflight (body colours, WCAG 2.2 focus ring, media reset, scrollbars), and the fumadocs colour bridge. Restyles the host app by design.

items.name: a11y-starter
items.title: A11y Starter
items.description: @interlace/ui — the three a11y primitives + the reduced-motion hook every consumer should install on day one.

items.name: layout-starter
items.title: Layout Starter
items.description: @interlace/ui — the six layout primitives that compose every page. One install, the LAYOUT_PHILOSOPHY contract is satisfied.

items.name: mdx-starter
items.title: MDX Starter
items.description: @interlace/ui — the components most MDX pipelines need (Callout, Prose, CodeBlock, Tag), wired through a default mdx-components.tsx.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn — class-name merge utility
items.description: @interlace/ui — the cn() helper, alias-compatible with shadcn. Merges Tailwind class lists deterministically.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion hook
items.description: @interlace/ui — the `useReducedMotion` hook every interactive primitive uses to gate animations on the user's OS preference.

items.name: theme-tokens
items.title: Theme token manifest
items.description: @interlace/ui — the registry of themes and the list of every `--interlace-*` token a theme must define. A missing token does not throw; it silently inherits the previous theme's value.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: useTheme hook
items.description: @interlace/ui — reads and writes the theme (`data-theme`) and colour scheme (`.dark`) axes, persists to localStorage, and follows the OS when no preference is stored.

items.name: use-reading-prefs
items.title: useReadingPrefs hook
items.description: @interlace/ui — reads and writes the reader's text size (`data-text-size`) and contrast (`data-contrast`) on <html>, persists both, and follows `prefers-contrast` when no choice is stored.

items.name: theme-script
items.title: No-flash theme bootstrap script
items.description: @interlace/ui — the inline `<head>` script that applies the stored theme before first paint. Without it every page load flashes the default theme.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A disclosure stack: a column of headers whose panels open and close. Wraps @base-ui/react/accordion — Base UI owns the open state (single or multiple), the keyboard model and every piece of the accordion ARIA.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal confirmation dialog for *destructive or otherwise consequential* actions ("Delete project", "Sign out everywhere"). Distinct from `Dialog`: the underlying Base UI primitive disables outside-click and Escape-only dismissal so the user MUST…

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A bordered in-page message with `role="alert"`, an optional leading icon, a title and a description, in two tones (default and destructive).

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A single block-level wrapper that reserves space by ratio (CSS `aspect-ratio`) and stretches to the parent's width. Use it as the *frame* for media that arrives async — images, video, embeds, charts — so the surrounding layout never shifts…

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A circular image with a text fallback. Wraps @base-ui/react/avatar: Base UI owns the image load/error state machine that decides when the fallback shows, and we own the surface.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small pill for a status, a count, a label or a tag. Renders a `<span>` by default, or whatever Base UI's `render` prop is given, so the same badge can be an anchor without losing its shape.

items.name: box
items.title: Box
items.description: The lowest-altitude layout primitive: surface + box-model on one element. Mirrors MUI `<Box>` (a polymorphic, unopinionated wrapper) minus the `sx` CSS-in-JS prop — Interlace uses a curated, tokenized cva variant set instead, so it cannot reopen the…

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A server-rendered, semantically-tagged trail of ancestor links. The compositional API mirrors the shadcn surface so consumers swap drop-in, and `BreadcrumbLink` keeps a server-safe `asChild` seam (`React.cloneElement`, NOT Base UI `useRender`) so the whole…

items.name: button-variants
items.title: Button Variants
items.description: The cva variant map that `button.tsx` imports — variant × size class strings and nothing else. Pure CVA: no React, no client APIs, so a server component can style a plain `<a>` with `buttonVariants({ variant, size })`.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The minimal-surface counterpart to [dialog.tsx](./dialog.tsx). Where Dialog exercises compound composition + portal + focus, Button exercises the variant + render-prop polymorphism + native-event passthrough surface.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: Inline-prose annotation. The "stop and read this" surface that punctuates long-form content (docs, MDX, READMEs). Distinct from `Alert` — Alert is an out-of-band runtime banner ("your save failed"), Callout is an in-band authored aside ("note: this rule is…

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered, rounded content surface with header / title / description / action / content / footer parts. The surface, radius and border come from `Box`; the card owns only its column layout, its padding and its shadow.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Tri-state boolean form control (checked / unchecked / indeterminate). Built on @base-ui/react/checkbox: Base UI owns `role="checkbox"`, `aria-checked="mixed"`, Space activation, and the controlled/uncontrolled pair (`checked` + `onCheckedChange` /…

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Fenced code block with a title bar (title left, language tag + copy button right). The copy action shells out to `navigator.clipboard.writeText` and flips an inline "Copied!" affordance for 1.5s — the only piece of state this primitive owns. Everything…

items.name: code-editor
items.title: Code Editor
items.description: CodeEditor — an editable code surface whose visual layer is DIAGNOSTICS, not syntax colour.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single open/close disclosure surface. Wraps Base UI's `Collapsible.Root`, `Collapsible.Trigger`, `Collapsible.Panel` so consumers get the controlled / uncontrolled state machine, ARIA wiring (`aria-controls`, `aria-expanded`, `id`), keyboard semantics…

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text input that filters a list. Built on `@base-ui/react/combobox`: Base UI owns the filtering (`Intl.Collator`-backed `useFilter`), the combobox/listbox ARIA pairing, VIRTUAL focus (the input keeps DOM focus and `aria-activedescendant` moves), single +…

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: ⌘K. A modal surface holding one filterable list of actions.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: The width contract from LAYOUT_PHILOSOPHY.md §2: four sizes only, each mapped to one layout token, plus the responsive horizontal padding scale `px-4 xs:px-6 lg:px-8` (§5).

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click / long-press menu. Wraps `@base-ui/react/context-menu` (same Menu compositional API as DropdownMenu, just with a Root that handles right-click / long-press / Shift+F10 as the open gesture).

items.name: data-state-model
items.title: Data State Model
items.description: Nothing in this file imports React, touches the DOM, or renders anything. It is the part of the absence contract that can be *proved* — the union, the precedence order, the announcement each state owes a screen reader, and the class set that paints it — so…

items.name: data-state
items.title: Data State
items.description: The single conditional swap point for a data surface, and the place the design system says what an ABSENCE is.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A MODAL dialog: it traps focus, dismisses on Escape and on an outside click, marks the rest of the page inert while open, and restores focus to the trigger on close. Base UI owns all of that, which is exactly why this file never says so anywhere else — and…

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets the reading direction once, for both halves of a component: the CSS and the keyboard.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and follows the finger: drag it back toward its edge and it goes, let go early and it settles back. The bottom sheet of a phone app, on the web. Base UI's Drawer owns the gesture, the open state, the focus trap, page…

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A button-triggered command menu — items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, plus a `Compose` array shorthand. Wraps @base-ui/react/menu: Base UI owns open state, positioning, focus and typeahead; we own the popup and the rows.

items.name: featured-icon
items.title: Featured Icon
items.description: An icon set in a tinted rounded square or circle, with a soft outer ring: the mark at the head of a feature card, a step, or a section. It gives a row of features one shared shape, so the icons read as a set rather than as loose glyphs of different weights.

items.name: focus-ring
items.title: Focus Ring
items.description: A `<span>` that paints the DS focus ring when anything inside it takes focus — `focus-within` on the wrapper, not `focus-visible` on the child.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A composition primitive over `@base-ui/react/field`. The form ecosystem owns a long tail of subtle a11y wiring — label/control association via generated ids, `aria-describedby` for description + error, `aria-invalid` flipping on validity, focus management…

items.name: grade-badge
items.title: Grade Badge
items.description: Visual grade pill — A+ / A / A- / B+ / B / … / F. The atomic surface for scorecard pages: a single chip that announces a tier without making the reader compute. Five tones (excellent/good/fair/poor/fail) map onto the 13-grade ladder so the colour story…

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: The 2-D sibling of Stack: a thin, token-bound CSS-grid primitive, not a grid framework. `<Grid>` sets the column track and gap on the foundation `--spacing` scale; `<GridItem>` spans columns, responsively. Two FLAT components rather than one with a `kind…

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A rich, non-modal overlay that opens on pointer-hover (and keyboard focus) of its trigger, used to preview the *contents* of a target — author cards, repo cards, link previews. Distinct from `Tooltip` (short, one-line, no interactive content) and `Popover`…

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text input. A pure surface primitive with no controlled-state machinery: the native `<input>` already owns selection, IME, undo/redo and `onChange`, so we add structure (surface, border, focus + invalid rings) without wrapping a single native…

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key the reader presses: `⌘`, `Esc`, `Ctrl` `K`. The shadcn core `kbd` item, drawn in Interlace tokens. `KbdGroup` sets a chord (`⌘ + K`) or a sequence (`G` then `I`) as one inline run, so the gap between keys is owned by the container, not by a margin on…

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form-control label. No headless dep — Base UI's `Field.Label` is the forms-aware variant (see `form.tsx`); this is the lower-level shadcn-canon label for controls that own their own id wiring. Server component. Mirrors…

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: A list whose markers carry the voice of the page: numbered claims, a row of checks, a "what we're not saying" list of crosses. The marker sits on the first line of each item, whatever the item holds: a sentence, rich text with inline `Citation` chips, a…

items.name: meter-scale
items.title: Meter Scale
items.description: The maths behind `Meter` and `RankedBarList`. No React, no DOM — the same split `charts/scale.ts` makes, and for the same reason: a bar that draws a beautiful wrong length is worse than one that fails to render, and the length is the part that can be…

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: ONE inline bar, absorbing three that were hand-rolled separately across the phase-10 corpus: an odds bar, a score meter and a reviewer bar. They differed in tone and in what the denominator meant; they did not differ in anything that justified three…

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A numeric input with increment/decrement controls and built-in scrubbing. Wraps @base-ui/react/number-field. Re-exports the compositional parts (Root, Group, Increment, Input, Decrement, ScrubArea) under DS-styled wrappers without owning state.

items.name: otp-field
items.title: Otp Field
items.description: A one-time code typed into a row of boxes, one character each: the "enter the 6-digit code we emailed you" field. Built on Base UI's OTPField, which owns the hard parts: paste of the whole code into any box, the phone's "from Messages" autofill…

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: The page-navigation bar: a `<nav aria-label="pagination">` of anchor links with previous / next / ellipsis parts. It is presentation only — it computes no page numbers and knows no total.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A non-modal floating panel anchored to its trigger. It dismisses on Escape and on an outside click and returns focus to the trigger, but it does NOT trap focus or make the page inert.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Determinate progress indicator. Wraps the Base UI `Progress` compound — Root, Track, Indicator, Label, Value — and re-exports DS-styled parts that consume theme tokens (no raw px, no hex). The Track defines the rail height (`size`); the Indicator carries…

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: The article-body wrapper. Renders an `<article>` whose descendants (`h1`–`h6`, `p`, `a`, `ul`/`ol`/`li`, `blockquote`, `code`/`pre`, `table`, `img`) get DS-token-mapped typography without per-element class gymnastics in the consumer. Think MDX-target…

items.name: published-date
items.title: Published Date
items.description: Article publish-date stamp. A pure surface primitive that renders a semantic `<time dateTime={iso}>` with a human-readable label produced by `Intl.DateTimeFormat` at render time. The native element owns the machine value (the `dateTime` attribute is what…

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Single-select control over 2+ mutually exclusive options. Built on @base-ui/react/radio-group + /radio: Base UI owns `role="radiogroup"`, roving-tabindex arrow navigation, and the controlled/uncontrolled pair (`value` + `onValueChange` / `defaultValue`).…

items.name: reading-settings
items.title: Reading Settings
items.description: A text size control and a More contrast toggle: two small controls for the reader, not the theme author. They write the `data-text-size` and `data-contrast` attributes on `<html>` through `useReadingPrefs`, remember the choice, and `THEME_SCRIPT` puts it…

items.name: reading-strand
items.title: Reading Strand
items.description: ReadingStrand — reading progress as the brand's draw verb: a single strand-a line at the top of the viewport that draws itself as the reader moves through the piece. BRAND_PHILOSOPHY: one strand, drawn — never faded.

items.name: reading-time
items.title: Reading Time
items.description: A compact "N min read" badge for article headers, blog cards and docs index rows. It renders an inline `<span>`, so it sits beside a date or a tag row without imposing block layout.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrollable region with a styled overlay scrollbar in place of the platform one. Wraps @base-ui/react/scroll-area: Base UI owns overflow detection and thumb geometry; we own the track, the thumb colour and the focus ring.

items.name: section-boundary
items.title: Section Boundary
items.description: The "stream per section" primitive. Fuses React Suspense + a class-based ErrorBoundary into one component so a template can render section-by-section with per-section skeleton + per-section error fallback. The page paints whatever's ready; slow / failed…

items.name: section-index
items.title: Section Index
items.description: SectionIndex — the numbered eyebrow: a zero-padded mono numeral in the AAA brand orange beside an uppercase tracked label. The page's sections become a legible sequence ("01 THE AGENDA … 04 THE PROOF"), telling readers there is an order and where they…

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: The page's rhythm unit, from LAYOUT_PHILOSOPHY.md §7-8: one band that owns its vertical padding, its background tone, its transition dividers and the `<Container>` that measures its children.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Single-select listbox with a portalled popup. Built on @base-ui/react/select: Base UI owns `role="combobox"` / `role="listbox"`, typeahead, arrow + Home/End navigation, focus return on close, and the controlled/uncontrolled pair (`value` + `onValueChange`…

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A one-pixel rule between blocks of content, horizontal or vertical. Wraps @base-ui/react/separator, which owns the `role` and `aria-orientation` semantics; this file owns exactly two things — the `bg-border` colour and the axis geometry.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal panel anchored to one edge of the viewport — a nav drawer, a filter panel, a settings pane. Base UI's Dialog owns the open state, the focus trap, page inerting, Escape and outside-press dismissal; we own the scrim, the slide and the side geometry.

items.name: skeleton-variants
items.title: Skeleton Variants
items.description: Single source of truth for the `<Skeleton variant>` discriminated union. Every entry maps to a Tailwind shape class set that paints a placeholder matching the corresponding primitive / pattern / template.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading-state placeholder. ONE component, many shapes — the `variant` prop picks the silhouette of the resting component being loaded so the page layout doesn't jump when real data arrives.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip Link
items.description: The "jump to main content" link that satisfies WCAG 2.4.1 (Bypass Blocks): an `sr-only` anchor that pops into the top-left corner the moment it takes focus, letting a keyboard user step past the header and nav in one Tab.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Range / value-picker primitive on top of @base-ui/react/slider. Compositional API: Slider.Root + Track + Indicator + Thumb. Re-exports the DS-styled surface (rail, fill, thumb) without owning state — Base UI handles keyboard (Arrow / Home / End / PageUp /…

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Flex layout whose gap comes from the DS six-step spacing scale, not from a number at the call site (LAYOUT_PHILOSOPHY.md §3). `Stack` stacks children vertically; `Cluster` is the horizontal, wrapping form for chip, tag and button rows.

items.name: stat-strip
items.title: Stat Strip
items.description: The measurement strip: a dense row of labelled numbers, each with an optional note and an optional change. It appeared in **all six** of the artifacts catalogued for phase 10, hand-rolled four separate times, and it is the smallest surface where the…

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Binary on/off control with immediate effect (no submit step) — the distinction from Checkbox, which collects a value for a form. Built on @base-ui/react/switch: Base UI owns `role="switch"`, `aria-checked`, Space/Enter activation and the…

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A tab bar and its panels. Wraps @base-ui/react/tabs: Base UI owns which tab is selected, arrow-key roving focus and the tablist/tab/tabpanel ARIA; we own the muted pill list and the raised face of the selected tab.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A tiny inline anchor used to surface taxonomy (rule categories, plugin tags, article topics). Two exports because tag chips almost always appear in a wrapping cluster — `TagList` ships the canonical `<ul>`-of-`<li>` semantics so consumers don't reinvent…

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input. A pure surface primitive with no controlled-state machinery: the native `<textarea>` already owns selection, IME, undo/redo, `onChange` etc., so we add structure (size + tone) without wrapping a single native behaviour. Server…

items.name: theme-switcher
items.title: Theme Switcher
items.description: The UI half of the two-axis theme contract (`styles/index.css`, `src/lib/use-theme.ts`). Two controls, because the two axes are genuinely different questions and a single control that tries to serve both ends up as a four-item list called "Light / Dark /…

items.name: thread-mark
items.title: Thread Mark
items.description: Interlace's thread, drawn as a state. Where a generic kit reaches for a spinner, an empty-box icon and a red warning triangle, Interlace says the same things with its one motif:

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient, portal-mounted notification. Wraps `@base-ui/react/toast` (Provider, Portal, Viewport, Root, Title, Description, Close) and overlays the Interlace tone system on top — four semantic tones (`info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`) that each render…

items.name: toc
items.title: Toc
items.description: The in-page Table of Contents. A long read needs a quiet map of its headings that shows where the reader is and lets them jump. On a wide layout it is a rail beside the text (`Toc`); on a narrow one it is a slim bar that names the current section and opens…

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button (pressed / not-pressed) and a grouped form thereof (mutually-exclusive or multi-select). Wraps @base-ui/react/toggle and @base-ui/react/toggle-group; we own the surface (size, variant, focus ring) and Base UI owns the pressed-state…

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls that acts as ONE stop in the Tab order: Tab enters the toolbar on its last-focused control and leaves it on the next Tab, and the arrow keys move between the controls inside, Home and End jump to the ends, and focus wraps. A formatting…

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label that appears beside its trigger on hover or on keyboard focus. Wraps @base-ui/react/tooltip and adds the one thing Base UI 1.6 does not emit: the `role="tooltip"` / `aria-describedby` pair.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: One component renders every row of the type scale (h1–h6, body, long-form, UI, caption, code) through a single `variant`, plus an orthogonal semantic `tone`. The reading-vs-UI distinction (TYPOGRAPHY_PHILOSOPHY "Reading mode vs UI mode") is encoded in the…

items.name: visually-hidden
items.title: Visually Hidden
items.description: A `<span>` that is invisible on screen but still read by assistive tech — the component form of the `sr-only` utility.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count Up
items.description: A number that counts to its value the first time it scrolls into view: "120 sources", "4.8k readers", "98%". The figure is the content, so the component is built around reading it, not around the motion.

items.name: decode-text
items.title: Decode Text
items.description: DecodeText — micro-labels resolve from glyph noise into their text.

items.name: edge-glow
items.title: Edge Glow
items.description: A light that runs around the edge of its parent: the plan you recommend, the card that is live right now. Drop it inside a positioned element:

items.name: gradient-mesh
items.title: Gradient Mesh
items.description: A soft, slowly shifting field of colour for a hero or a feature band. A few large blurred glows, each a theme colour, drift on long loops over a base surface, so the band feels alive without anything a reader has to watch. Content goes in `children` and…

items.name: grid-field
items.title: Grid Field
items.description: Graph-paper lines (or a dot grid) behind a section, with a few cells that slowly light up and fade, like squares being filled in on a worksheet. It says "careful, measured work" without saying anything.

items.name: hero-strand
items.title: Hero Strand
items.description: HeroStrand — the thread at page scale: one strand-a ribbon drawn across a hero section, optionally crossed by the strand-b counter. Completes the four scales of "One thread, every scale" (micro: DecodeText, component: InterlaceWeave, page: TimelineMap…

items.name: interlace-weave
items.title: Interlace Weave
items.description: InterlaceWeave — the brand gesture as an interaction signature.

items.name: light-beam
items.title: Light Beam
items.description: A soft cone of light falling into a dark section from an edge, the way a stage light picks out a speaker. It draws the eye to the headline under it and gives a flat surface depth. It does not move: the light is part of the set, not an event.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Any block that arrives as it scrolls into view: a section heading, a card, a figure, a quote. It fades in and, depending on `effect`, rises a little, comes into focus or grows to size, once. Use it on the few things a reader should notice arriving, not on…

items.name: rotating-text
items.title: Rotating Text
items.description: One word in a headline that changes every few seconds ("Build for [teams / founders / students]"). It is a familiar pattern done carefully: the line never jumps, a screen reader hears the sentence once, and the reader can stop it.

items.name: scroller
items.title: Scroller
items.description: A row (or column) of items that glides past on a loop: logos of the organisations you work with, short quotes, headlines. The items are real content, so the component treats them that way first and as motion second.

items.name: sheen-text
items.title: Sheen Text
items.description: A word or short phrase painted with a slow, travelling gradient: the one word of a headline that carries the promise. Use it once per view, on a few words, never on body text.

items.name: sheen
items.title: Sheen
items.description: A soft band of light that crosses its parent every few seconds. Drop it inside the one button or card a page most wants pressed:

items.name: sky-backdrop
items.title: Sky Backdrop
items.description: A calm daytime sky for a friendly hero: a soft gradient, a warm sun glow in one corner, and a few clouds drifting across. It suits pages that want warmth rather than drama, the light counterpart to `Starfield`.

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: A headline or short line that arrives a word, or a letter, at a time the first time it scrolls into view. It gives one line on a page a moment of attention; use it once or twice per page, on text short enough to read while it arrives.

items.name: stagger-list
items.title: Stagger List
items.description: A list whose items arrive one after another the first time it scrolls into view: steps of a process, recent updates, the points of an argument. The arrival gives the eye an order to read in; the list itself is ordinary.

items.name: starfield
items.title: Starfield
items.description: A night sky behind a hero: still stars, a share of them breathing, an occasional shooting star and a few slow meteors. Everything is painted on ONE `<canvas>` driven by ONE animation frame loop, so the whole sky costs a single layer and a single callback…

items.name: thread-lines
items.title: Thread Lines
items.description: Interlace's own backdrop: a loose bundle of threads running across a section, crossing and parting the way strands do in a weave, with a small glint of light travelling along each one. It is the brand mark (two strands, interlaced) at the scale of a page.

items.name: weave-texture
items.title: Weave Texture
items.description: A quiet woven cloth behind a section: warp threads in `--strand-a` and weft threads in `--strand-b`, passing over and under each other in a plain weave. It is texture, not glow: nothing moves, nothing shines, and at the default strength it sits just above…

items.name: article-card
items.title: Article Card
items.description: Two article tiles that share one focusable-anchor shell: `ArticleCard`, the stacked grid tile with the cover on top, and `FeaturedArticleCard`, the full-bleed hero whose copy sits on a gradient scrim over the image. Both read the same props.

items.name: article-list-grid
items.title: Article List Grid
items.description: Grid of ArticleCards with an optional featured slot above. The pattern blog index pages reach for: one big featured card (overlay variant) above N tiles. Composes RelatedPosts-style streaming with proper loading + empty states.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: A titled audio clip with its transcript. The player is the browser's own `<audio controls>`: it is keyboard- and screen-reader-operable on every platform, honours the OS media keys, and needs no JavaScript from us. What this pattern adds is the frame…

items.name: author-byline
items.title: Author Byline
items.description: The "who wrote this + when + how long it takes to read" adornment that sits directly under an article H1. Pure surface composition over existing primitives — Avatar (large) on the left, a vertical Stack on the right with author name (UI semibold), optional…

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A thin, full-width bar above the site header for a message that applies to the whole site: "This site is still being written", a scheduled outage, a new release. One line of text, an optional link, and an optional close button.

items.name: brand-logo
items.title: Brand Logo
items.description: The locked two-bar Interlace mark plus the lowercase monospace wordmark "interlace". This is the SAME lockup eslint.interlace.tools ships in its top nav — one component so every *.interlace.tools site renders an identical brand header instead of…

items.name: citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: An inline source marker for a sentence that makes a claim. The reader taps or tabs to the marker and a popover lists every source behind the claim: who published it, what kind of source it is, and the exact words quoted from it. Several sources stack in…

items.name: claim-card
items.title: Claim Card
items.description: One claim, examined. The card quotes a claim as a reader heard it, gives a short answer, and keeps the evidence one click away in collapsible sections: the facts and their sources, who makes the claim, where the record is contested, what the answer does…

items.name: code-window
items.title: Code Window
items.description: macOS-style window chrome for wrapping editor, terminal, or code-preview content: a bordered `bg-card` box plus an optional title bar with the three traffic-light dots, a centred monospace filename, and an actions slot.

items.name: cta-section
items.title: Cta Section
items.description: Call-to-action section. Title + description + 1-2 action buttons in a centred column on a tinted surface. The shape every landing page reaches for ("Ready to ship?" / "Start your trial" / "Read the docs"). Server component.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Columns, sorting, row selection, pagination, and the three states a table spends most of its life in (loading / empty / error). It composes primitives — Checkbox, Pagination, Skeleton, Button — so it is a pattern, not a primitive.

items.name: dialogue-stepper
items.title: Dialogue Stepper
items.description: A `Dialogue` the reader steps through: one step of turns at a time, each revealed by a choice ("What do I say?", "They might ask…"). A choice can branch to any step, the reader can go back, reset, or show the whole conversation at once. Use it for a…

items.name: dialogue
items.title: Dialogue
items.description: A written conversation: a script of turns, each with a speaker. Use it for a sample support chat, an interview excerpt, or a worked example of a hard conversation. Turns from the two sides sit on opposite edges so the back-and-forth reads at a glance, and…

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: The "nothing here yet" surface. Used wherever a list, table, or search returns zero rows AND the consumer can act on it (create the first item, adjust filters, link to docs). Empty states are first-class UX, not an afterthought — `LOADING_PHILOSOPHY` flags…

items.name: faq
items.title: Faq
items.description: Frequently-asked-questions accordion. Composes the canonical Accordion primitive into a single-prop API: pass an array of {question, answer} and get the full disclosure pattern (keyboard, ARIA, animation) inherited from Accordion → Base UI.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: Grid of small "feature" cards: icon + title + 1-2 line description. The shape every landing page reaches for to spell out "what we do" in 3-6 cells. Server component, no hooks.

items.name: figure
items.title: Figure
items.description: Semantic media block. `<figure>` is the right element for *self-contained* media (image, diagram, code screenshot, chart) with an optional caption that scrolls with it. Composes `AspectRatio` so the layout reserves space before the asset loads — preventing…

items.name: flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
items.description: A card with two faces: a front that asks (a claim, a question) and a back that answers (with any children, such as source links). Pressing the card turns it over in 3D. It makes the reader commit to a guess before the answer arrives, which is what turns a…

items.name: focus-grid
items.title: Focus Grid
items.description: A grid of picture cards where the one you point at or tab to stays bright and the others step back. It helps a reader compare a few visual options (destinations, case studies, chapters) without the grid feeling busy.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: Site footer with grouped link columns + copyright row. Composes with a primary brand mark, 1-4 link groups (each a sub-heading + list of links), and a tail row for copyright + social. Server component.

items.name: guess-reveal
items.title: Guess Reveal
items.description: A one-question quiz: a question, two to four answers as buttons, and an explanation that opens once the reader picks. The pick is marked right or wrong with a short movement, the right answer is always shown, and the consumer hears about it through…

items.name: hero-cosmic
items.title: Hero Cosmic
items.description: The cosmic landing hero: a full-height gradient surface carrying a twinkling starfield, shooting stars and meteors behind an eyebrow / headline / tagline / two-CTA column. A preset, not a kit — pass copy and CTAs and the decorative layer is already wired.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The above-the-fold section every landing page reaches for: eyebrow, headline, supporting copy, primary + secondary CTAs, optional media slot. Server-component-safe; the calm-confident-technical voice is enforced by Typography variants (no h1 with…

items.name: lint-playground
items.title: Lint Playground
items.description: LintPlayground — paste code, watch analysis light it up.

items.name: newsletter-form
items.title: Newsletter Form
items.description: Canonical email-signup pattern: title + (optional) description + email field + consent checkbox + submit. Composition of the auth primitive set (Form / Field / Input / Button + Checkbox + Typography). The block owns *structure*; consumers wire `action` and…

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The header band at the top of admin / docs / settings pages. Carries a breadcrumb (optional), title, optional description, and a right-aligned actions slot (typically a primary CTA + an optional menu). Renders a `<header>` landmark for screen-reader…

items.name: prev-next-post
items.title: Prev Next Post
items.description: Paired previous / next link cards rendered at the foot of an article. The canonical "what to read next" surface — improves session depth, reduces bounce, and gives keyboard / screen-reader users a deterministic exit ramp from long-form content. Wrapped in…

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: 2-4 column pricing-tier grid. Each tier is a card with name, price, description, feature list, and a CTA button. The "Most popular" tier gets a highlight border. Server component.

items.name: reading-layout
items.title: Reading Layout
items.description: A long read with its table of contents: the text column, and beside it a `Toc` rail that stays in view as the reader scrolls. When the layout is too narrow for a rail, the contents fold into a slim bar (`TocBar`) that sticks to the top of the column, names…

items.name: related-posts
items.title: Related Posts
items.description: "Keep reading" surface that sits at the foot of an article page (or any long-form route). Renders an h3 section heading followed by a responsive grid of ArticleCards: one column on phones, two from `md` up, three from `lg` up — the same 1/2/3 cadence the…

items.name: scorecard-row
items.title: Scorecard Row
items.description: A single dimension row in a scorecard: name + GradeBadge + numeric score + optional details. Used by ScorecardTemplate to render each scored category (Performance, Coverage, Adoption, ...).

items.name: section-header
items.title: Section Header
items.description: The "section intro" block — optional eyebrow, a heading, and a `max-w-prose` tagline — with the bottom margin, the alignment and the type rhythm owned in one place instead of being re-typed as `text-center mb-12` on every section.

items.name: share-buttons
items.title: Share Buttons
items.description: A compact "share this page" cluster: one ghost icon-button per social network plus a copy-link affordance. Each share button opens its network's prefilled share URL in a new tab; the copy button writes the URL to the clipboard and flips its icon +…

items.name: side-by-side
items.title: Side By Side
items.description: Two (or three) accounts of the same thing, set next to each other so the reader compares them line by line: what is said and what the record shows, before and after, one source and another. Columns stack on narrow screens, in source order, so the…

items.name: sign-in-form
items.title: Sign In Form
items.description: Canonical sign-in pattern: title + email + password + submit. Composition of the auth primitive set (Form / Field / Input / Button + Typography for the title). The block owns *structure*; consumers wire `action` / `onSubmit` and pass the brand specifics…

items.name: sign-in-methods
items.title: Sign In Methods
items.description: The "ways you can sign in" list on an account page: one row per method (Google, Apple, email…), each with its mark, what it is linked to, and a Connect or Disconnect button. Disconnecting asks once more in place ("Disconnect" → "Yes, disconnect" /…

items.name: social-sign-in
items.title: Social Sign In
items.description: "Continue with Google / Apple / X / …" plus an optional email link, in one form. Pick the providers and their order; the first `featured` ones get a full-width button with their name, the rest share a row of icon buttons, and the provider the visitor used…

items.name: stance-list
items.title: Stance List
items.description: Who holds which position on a question. Each row names a holder (a person, a group, a school of thought), labels their position with a toned badge, and says it in a sentence or two, optionally with a source.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: A single labeled metric — the building block of dashboards, scorecards, and "key results" rows. Renders: label / value / optional delta / optional icon. The `tone` variant pairs the delta accent with one of four semantic colors (default / success / warning…

items.name: stat-group
items.title: Stat Group
items.description: Horizontal row (or grid) of StatCards. The pattern stat pages reach for: 3-5 hero KPIs at the top of a page, each a labelled big number. Server component.

items.name: status-pills
items.title: Status Pills
items.description: A row of short facts about the page, set as pills: "Reviewed", "9 facts", "38 sources", "4 min read". Built to sit on a brand band (`<Section tone="brand">`) under a title, and just as readable on the page background.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: Quote + attribution surfaces. Single Testimonial cells render an blockquote with an author avatar; TestimonialGrid lays them out in a 1-3 column grid. Server components.

items.name: thread-steps
items.title: Thread Steps
items.description: An ordered sequence held together by Interlace's woven thread: a knot for each step, and two strands that cross between one knot and the next. The strands draw in as the reader reaches each step, so the motion says one thing only: this leads to that.

items.name: timeline-map
items.title: Timeline Map
items.description: TimelineMap — dated entities as linked dots on a shared time axis, one labeled strip per category lane.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A short record in date order: each event has a date, a title, what was said or done, and where that comes from. In a wide column the events sit side by side on a horizontal rule; in a narrow one they stack down a vertical rule. The switch keys on the…

items.name: topbar-menu
items.title: Topbar Menu
items.description: The small-screen half of `Topbar`: a "Menu" button that opens the site's links in a panel at the edge of the screen. Topbar renders it for you below `md`; it is exported on its own for headers that compose their own row.

items.name: topbar-nav
items.title: Topbar Nav
items.description: The wide-screen half of `Topbar` when its links hold groups: a row of plain links and group triggers, where a group opens a panel of its items, each with an optional icon and a one-line description. It is how a site that is a family of products lists them…

items.name: topbar-scroll-edge
items.title: Topbar Scroll Edge
items.description: The client half of `Topbar edge="scroll"`: it marks the header `data-scrolled` once the page has moved off its top, so the bar can sit clear over a hero and gain its surface and border only when content passes beneath it. With `hide` it also marks the…

items.name: topbar
items.title: Topbar
items.description: Site-wide horizontal navigation. The first pattern every landing / docs / dashboard surface needs: logo (left), primary nav (middle/right), action cluster (right). One row, sticky to the top, semi-transparent backdrop blur so content scrolls visibly…

items.name: wordmark
items.title: Wordmark
items.description: A text logo of one or more stacked lines: a name over its tagline, or the same name in several languages or scripts. Each line is a `Wordmark.Line` with its own `lang` (and `dir` for a right-to-left script), so a screen reader, a hyphenator and the…

items.name: delta
items.title: Delta
items.description: "It moved, this much, this way." The smallest complete unit of analysis and the most-repeated element in a dense view, so it is worth getting exactly right once.

items.name: distribution
items.title: Distribution
items.description: One quantity spread across a fixed set of bins — hours of the day, days of the week, cohorts, buckets — with an optional REFERENCE distribution drawn over it.

items.name: metric-table
items.title: Metric Table
items.description: The roic.ai row: metric name, values across time, sparkline, delta. Click a row to promote it into whatever chart the caller renders above.

items.name: network-graph
items.title: Network Graph
items.description: Who is connected to whom, and who the network converges on.

items.name: radial-weave
items.title: Radial Weave
items.description: The same series `TimeSeries` plots, wrapped around a dial — the POSTER form: identity and shape, composed to be looked at and shared.

items.name: seat-chart
items.title: Seat Chart
items.description: How an assembly divides its seats: a half-circle of dots, one per seat, filled group by group. It answers the question a results table cannot answer at a glance: who holds the room, and how far each side is from a majority.

items.name: series-table
items.title: Series Table
items.description: The data behind a chart, as a real `<table>`.

items.name: share-chart
items.title: Share Chart
items.description: How a whole splits into parts, one bar per row: survey answers by group, a budget by department, time by activity. Each row is one 100% bar cut into segments, and every row shares one scale, so rows compare at a glance.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A trend in the width of a table cell. The densest thing in the package: it exists so a `MetricTable` row can show *shape* without spending a chart's worth of pixels, which is the whole roic.ai lesson — one row that reads a decade beats one chart that reads…

items.name: time-series
items.title: Time Series
items.description: One metric over time, with the actions that moved it drawn ON the curve.

items.name: streak
items.title: Streak
items.description: A player's run of days: the count, a line on where today stands, and a strip of recent days, each marked played, rested, missed or still open. Rest days come from a `RestRule` (weekdays and dates that never break a run), so a habit does not punish a day…

items.name: article-template
items.title: Article Template
items.description: Full-page surface for long-form articles. Composes the header (title + AuthorByline), the body (Prose-wrapped MDX/HTML), the related-posts grid, prev/next navigation, and share buttons — each in its own `<SectionBoundary>` so the page streams section-by-…

items.name: auth-template
items.title: Auth Template
items.description: Full-page surface for sign-in / sign-up / password-reset / verify-email flows. Centred narrow column with brand mark at top, form in the middle, helper link at the bottom ("Already have an account?" / "Forgot password?").

items.name: author-template
items.title: Author Template
items.description: Author profile page — bio header + their articles grid. Used by `/authors/[slug]` routes on a blog. The bio header is a multi-part card (avatar + name + role + bio + social links); the grid uses ArticleListGrid for the article list.

items.name: blog-home-template
items.title: Blog Home Template
items.description: Blog index surface. Topbar + hero (greeting / about) + ArticleListGrid (featured + recent) + optional NewsletterForm + Footer. The shape every personal / company blog reaches for.

items.name: dashboard-template
items.title: Dashboard Template
items.description: Application dashboard surface. Topbar at top, persistent left sidebar (nav links), main content area (children). The standard "logged-in app" layout: every SaaS dashboard reaches for this shape.

items.name: docs-page-template
items.title: Docs Page Template
items.description: Documentation page surface. Topbar at top, optional sidebar nav on the left (md+), main content in the centre with a `<Prose>` wrapper, and an optional TOC rail on the right (xl+).

items.name: error-template
items.title: Error Template
items.description: Full-page error surface — 404 / 500 / 503 / generic. Centred column with the status code + title + description + action buttons (back home, contact support, retry).

items.name: landing-template
items.title: Landing Template
items.description: Marketing landing page surface. Composes Topbar + Hero + (optional) FeatureGrid + (optional) TestimonialGrid + (optional) PricingTable + (optional) FAQ + CTASection + Footer — each in its own SectionBoundary so the page streams section-by-section.

items.name: registry-item-template
items.title: Registry Item Template
items.description: Full-page surface for a single registry item's documentation (`/c/[name]` on ds.interlace.tools). Composes the header (item name + description + install snippet), the anatomy diagram, the variants matrix, related-components grid, and a CTA back to the…

items.name: scorecard-template
items.title: Scorecard Template
items.description: Graded-evaluation page. Topbar + overall-grade header + per-dimension scorecard rows + optional methodology footnote + Footer.

items.name: settings-template
items.title: Settings Template
items.description: Account / app settings surface. Topbar + left tab-rail (sections) + main content area (rendered section). Server-friendly; the active section is driven by the consumer's routing (each section is a route).

items.name: stats-template
items.title: Stats Template
items.description: Public-facing metrics page. Topbar + header (title + lead) + SectionBoundary(StatGroup) + SectionBoundary(arbitrary chart/table content) + optional methodology footnote + Footer.

items.name: tag-template
items.title: Tag Template
items.description: Tag-filtered article index. Used by `/tags/[slug]` routes on a blog to show "all articles tagged #typescript" etc. Shows a header ("Tagged: #typescript") then an ArticleListGrid of matching posts.
